sample_unit: questions (top-10 Google FAQs per domain across two domains, each answered by 3 platforms)

links.outcome: Readability (Flesch-Kincaid grade level) of LLM and Google answers to cartilage repair questions
links.effect: Grade Level 12.6-13.2 for Google vs. 15.7-17.4 for LLMs, far above typical patient reading levels; Google's lower score attributed to snippet brevity.
links.quote: Readability analysis paradoxically favored Google (Grade Level 12.6-13.2 vs. 15.7-17.4 for LLMs), attributable to extreme snippet brevity inflating formulaic scores rather than genuine comprehensibility.

unlisted_practices: Matching AI tools to stakeholder-specific roles (patient education vs clinical decision support) rather than one-size-fits-all
Comparing LLM answer quality against Google Search using blinded raters

screen.reason: Empirical evaluation/benchmark of LLMs (ChatGPT, DeepSeek) versus Google Search on cartilage repair FAQs using blinded raters, assessing accuracy, safety, and readability, without testing a specific organizational safeguard or deployment intervention.
